question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Only when the floods get _______ will world governments begin to act.
solution:
The correct answer is '**worse**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**worse**" refers to something that is more severe or of lower quality compared to a previous condition. (बदतर)
 
• In the context of the sentence, it implies that the condition of floods needs to deteriorate further before governments will take action.
 
• The other options: "**lucky**," "**frequently**," and "**polite**" are not contextually suitable.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Only when the floods get worse__ will world governments begin to act.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lucky (भाग्यशाली)**: means having good fortune, which doesn’t fit the sentence.
 
• **Frequently (अक्सर)**: means occurring often, which doesn’t align with the context.
 
• **Polite (विनम्र)**: means showing good manners, which doesn’t relate to the situation.
